name: Helix
tagline: A post-modern modal text editor built in Rust with tree-sitter & LSP
description: Helix is a modern, terminal-based modal text editor inspired by Kakoune and Neovim. It features multiple selections, built-in language server (LSP) support, and tree-sitter syntax highlighting out of the box with zero configuration.
features: Built-in Language Server Protocol (LSP) client without plugins
Tree-sitter syntax highlighting and structural code navigation
Modern terminal GUI themes and lightning-fast Rust core
requirements: Linux x86_64, modern terminal with truecolor support
